snippet.title: Steve's Warehouse - Official gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Steve's Warehouse is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deck-building. Purchase objects, combine them, but don't make any falls!

Steve's Warehouse will release on Steam in July 2025
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902440/Steves_Warehouse/
Try out the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2969070/Steves_Warehouse_Demo/
